label: Basic
description: Basic table. Best for a plain invoice list with a caption under the rows, a payment method column and status written as text.

label: With Footer
description: Table with footer. Best for a footer row whose Total label spans 2 columns beside a bold sum of the amounts.

label: Status Badges
description: Table in card with status badges. Best for a 2 column task list set inside a Card, with a tinted status badge end aligned.

label: Actions Column
description: Table card with actions column. Best for a dots menu on each product row that opens Edit, Duplicate and a destructive Delete.

label: Interactive Rows
description: Table with interactive elements. Best for a number stepper in each row for changing a quantity in place, inside a Card.

label: Team Members
description: Team members table with avatars, roles, and status. Best for team members with avatar, name and email over role and presence badges, inside a Frame panel.

label: Orders
description: Orders table with customer info and payment status. Best for recent orders with a monospace order number, a customer name over the order date beside an avatar, and a right aligned amount.

label: Projects
description: Projects table with team avatars and status. Best for projects with a folder icon tile, stacked team avatars plus an overflow count and a due date.

label: Activity Log
description: Activity log table with user avatars and timestamps. Best for an audit trail of who did what, with an action badge, a monospace target such as a branch and a relative time.

label: Subscriptions
description: Subscriptions table with plan badges and billing info. Best for software subscriptions with a plan badge, monthly price, next billing date and a Manage button on each row.

label: Inventory
description: Product inventory table with stock badges and prices. Best for products with a SKU under the name, a stock level badge beside the unit count and an Edit, Restock, Archive menu.

label: API Keys
description: API keys table with permission badges and actions. Best for masked secret keys in a code chip, with xs permission badges and icon buttons to copy or regenerate.

label: File Manager
description: File manager table with owners and sharing badges. Best for files and folders with a type icon, owner avatar, a sharing scope badge, size and last modified time.

label: Issues
description: Issues table with priority, assignee, and labels. Best for issue rows with a monospace ID, a title followed by an outline label badge, the assignee and a status badge.

label: Leaderboard
description: Leaderboard table with rank, score, and level badges. Best for a ranked list with a position number, player handle, level badge, formatted score and a colored up or down change.

label: Employee Profile
description: Vertical table with employee profile details. Best for one employee’s details as label and value rows, with a shaded label column.

label: Server Config
description: Vertical table with server configuration details. Best for a titled server panel with a pulsing status dot, CPU and memory bars and tag badges.
